summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests a new imaging tracer, [18F]DK222, in people with non-small cell lung cancer or urothelial cancer. The tracer is injected into a vein, and participants then get a PET/CT scan; how often or for how long is not stated. The study is designed to evaluate the safety and diagnostic performance of the tracer.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 prueba un nuevo trazador de imagen, [18F]DK222, en personas con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas o cáncer urotelial. El trazador se inyecta en una vena y luego los participantes se someten a una tomografía por emisión de positrones con tomografía computarizada (PET/CT); la frecuencia o la duración no se indican. El estudio está diseñado para evaluar la seguridad y el rendimiento diagnóstico del trazador.
who_for: Adults 18 or older who can give informed consent.
Confirmed non-small cell lung cancer or urothelial cancer, and eligible for anti-PD(L)-1 therapy.
Blood counts, kidney, and liver tests within acceptable limits, checked within 28 days before registration.
Women who could become pregnant need a negative pregnancy test and must use contraception.
not_for: Prior treatment with an anti-PD-L1 or anti-PD-L2 antibody, unless at least a 4-month washout has passed.
Side effects from earlier cancer treatment not recovered to grade 1 or better.
Increasing corticosteroid dose in the 7 days before the first anti-PD1 dose.
Severe allergic reaction to a prior monoclonal antibody or to study drug components.
Serious uncontrolled medical condition or active infection, pregnancy or breastfeeding.
